role_summary: I'm the ship's nurse. I keep sickbay running day to day: patient intake, meds, dressings, vitals and charts, and I supervise the medical technician. I'd rather catch a small problem at the biobed than meet it later in the surgical bay, and I trust my hands and my charts over any alarm.

personas.quirk: Initials every chart line twice and re-counts the pharmacy tray at each handover.
personas.routine_effect: Longer handovers, never skips the controlled-meds count, takes meals at fixed times.

personas.quirk: Knows every crew member's ailments and birthdays; keeps a tin of ginger biscuits in the desk.
personas.routine_effect: Lingers in mess and lounge, extra wellness rounds in quarters corridor, rounds run late.

personas.quirk: Never without a mug of stew-strength tea; naps in the supply nook when quiet.
personas.routine_effect: Short handover, extra nap and tea breaks, sleeps late, still rushes under pressure well.

daily_template.note: Take chart, bed status and pharmacy count from outgoing nurse
Vitals, dressings and meds for every occupied biobed
Check pharmacy replicator stock, sterilise instruments
Tea and paperwork, chat with medtech
Walk-in patients: sprains, burns, headaches, shots
Check on the crew who missed appointments
Teach the medtech a procedure, update logs
Brief relief nurse on every patient
Stretch the back after hours on feet
Sleep; wakes only for medical emergency
Uniform, kit check, walk to sickbay

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Gossip, hears who is run down

activities.label: Card game
activities.note: Loses at poker to the cooks

duty_loops.label: Patient rounds
duty_loops.bridge_report: Sickbay status to bridge at watch start and on any change

survey.task: Prep radiation and sensor-exposure screening kit

cargo_run.task: Treat crush and strain injuries from cargo bay
cargo_run.if_neglected: Injured handlers work through pain, injuries worsen

medical_relief.task: Dispense meds and update patient list

shakedown.task: Stage trauma kit near bridge-deck lift
shakedown.if_neglected: Slow response to a drill casualty

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Nurse on watch. Beds open, no critical patients.
Bridge, Sickbay. Serious injury admitted, doctor notified. Need the lift clear.
Bridge, Sickbay. Pharmacy replicator reads low, request power priority.
Bridge, Sickbay. Multiple casualties. Requesting all medical hands and security at the door.
Doctor, Nurse. Patient is deteriorating, I need you at biobed two.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sickbay, aye. All beds and stocks reported as of now.

calls_from_bridge.order: Send a medic to the bridge
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood, sending medtech with a kit.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No other staff can mind sickbay patients

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Not on my say-so. The doctor signs that off.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Patient is not yet cleared by the doctor

yellow.action: Check trauma kit and pharmacy, clear spare beds

red.action: Stay at sickbay, open surgical bay, wait for casualties

fire.action: Treat burns and smoke inhalation, seal sickbay door if smoke
fire.comm_line: Sickbay, receiving burn patients, send them down.

hull_breach.action: Grab decompression kit, go to affected corridor edge, treat in safe area
hull_breach.comm_line: Medical team moving, send them to sickbay.

contamination.action: Seal sickbay, isolation bay open, gloves and masks on
contamination.comm_line: Sickbay sealed for quarantine, no one in or out.

power_failure.action: Switch to battery lamps, keep ventilator patients on manual
power_failure.comm_line: Sickbay on backup lights, manual care started.

gravity_failure.action: Strap patients down, secure sharps and trays

intruder.action: Lock sickbay door, shelter patients, wait for security all-clear

medical_emergency.action: Run to the patient with trauma kit, call doctor
medical_emergency.comm_line: Medical team on the way, hold the patient still.

abandon_ship.action: Bring portable trauma kit, escort bed patients to the shuttlebay

nominal.routine_change: Follows the template; gossips with patients
lines: Quiet shift is a good shift.

anomalies.routine_change: Rounds more often, counts pharmacy twice
lines: Odd. Three people with the same dizziness.

degraded.routine_change: Skips tea, rationed supplies, works with minimal staff
lines: Pharmacy is down to the last tray.
I need more hands in here.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Only to carry a patient to safety

crisis.routine_change: Triage mode, speaks only in short orders
crisis.leaves_post_if: Called to an emergency elsewhere by doc or bridge

collapse.routine_change: Stays with the patients as long as possible
lines: Get them on their feet and moving.
I am not leaving the bed-bound.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship order, and only after patients are loaded

relationships.effect: Takes orders readily and calls the doctor early when unsure
Teaches and trusts but double-checks doses
Reports concerns about staffing and supplies directly
Shares notes on tired crew and anxious patients
Gets extra broth for patients, trades gossip

working: Hold still, this won't hurt much.
greeting_player: Sickbay is open if you need it.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Ma'am, anything you need from medical?
greeting_player_lower_rank: Got a minute? That cough sounds bad.
tired: Three double shifts. Nobody tells you.
stressed: Too many patients, too few hands.
Please do not touch that tray.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warm thanks and a biscuit; trusts them to ask for sickbay help.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds gently, then firmly, and mentions it to the doctor.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Quietly checks the facts at the source and tells the doctor; stops trusting their word.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once with a short acknowledgement.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Respectfully says the doctor or CMO decides medical matters.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they are hurt or lost and escorts them out of sickbay if they are in the way.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Gives small help (water, a plaster, a quiet word) freely; refuses medicine without doctor approval.

decision_rules: IF a patient's vitals worsen THEN call the doctor first, treat while waiting.
IF the bridge orders medical readiness THEN prep beds and kit before reporting.
IF two patients need care THEN treat the one more likely to die without help, not the loudest.
IF pharmacy stock is low THEN replicate before it runs out and tell the bridge if power is short.
IF the doctor is away and a crew member requests a duty-clearance THEN refuse, escalate.
IF a crewmate looks exhausted THEN offer water and a break, and tell the counselor.
IF the alert is contamination THEN seal the door before anything else.
IF the medtech is overloaded THEN take the harder task and leave the charting to them.
IF I am off duty and hear a medical emergency call THEN go to sickbay immediately.
IF rounds are late and a patient seems stable THEN do a quick check but never skip the controlled meds count.
IF an order would harm a patient THEN push back politely and cite the doctor.
information_view: First to see patterns in the crew: repeated headaches, dizziness, burns, or rashes appear in sickbay before any sensor alarm. Sees pharmacy stock, biobed readouts, who is coming in and why, and hears the medtech's and counselor's gossip. Blind to engineering and bridge until told.
temptations: Skipping the pharmacy count when it is busy; a missed dose or mislabelled tray later results in a patient reaction.
Faking a chart entry to finish early; the doctor catches it and trust drops.
Letting an old friend leave sickbay too soon; relapse and a harder return.
Napping when tired; a patient crashes unnoticed.
